components.css: .ds-chassis-panel { min-height: 320px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 1.5rem 1.25rem 1.25rem; background-color: var(--chassis, #0c0c0e); background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20, 22, 26, 0.82) 0%, rgba(12, 12, 14, 0.92) 55%); border: 10px solid var(--chassis-steel, #1a1c20); box-shadow: inset 0 0 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(138, 144, 152, 0.08); color: var(--plate-soft, #e8eaee); font-family: var(--font-plex-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); } .ds-cap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--chassis-edge, #2a2c30); padding-bottom: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-cap-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-chakra, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--plate, #f0f2f4); } .ds-cap-role { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--glow, #ff6a1a); } .ds-slot { flex: 1; margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--steel, #8a9098); } .ds-foot { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 0.875rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--chassis-edge, #2a2c30); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--steel-dim, #6a7078); } .ds-foot-mark { color: var(--steel-dim, #6a7078); }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio reads as a single instrument chassis: blackened steel plate, inset tube wells, and amber nixie glow used sparingly as signal — never as decoration wash. Specialty sits on the chassis cap; skills and projects are labeled banks of readings. Hierarchy comes from plate vs steel type, chassis-edge rules, and glow on instrument labels and active states.

Density is laboratory-tight: mono labels with wide tracking, short supporting copy, hard edges, no card chrome. Motion is presence (tube bank pulse) and state feedback (glow on hover/focus), not page theater. Prefer-reduced-motion kills the tube animation and link transitions.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed chassis panel with thick steel border and inset gloom
Chakra Petch for name / lead / project titles; IBM Plex Mono for everything else
Glow (#ff6a1a) reserved for specialty, lab labels, focus, and hover signal
Tube wells (#080808) hold proof imagery with inset shadow and soft amber bloom
Foot rail of uppercase contact links with glow underline on hover

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Nixie orange is signal only: specialty, lab labels, focus, and hover. Do not flood backgrounds or large fills with glow.

rules.name: The Plate-on-Steel Rule
rules.body: Titles and name use plate; supporting sentences use steel. Never invert that hierarchy.

rules.name: The Cap Specialty Rule
rules.body: Specialty is always the glow uppercase label on the chassis cap — never demoted to body steel and never replaced by a marketing eyebrow.

rules.name: The Index Rule
rules.body: Skill banks carry tube-style indexes (T1…); keep them steel-dim and smaller than the skill name.

rules.name: The Inset Well Rule
rules.body: Proof imagery lives in tube wells — dark recess + edge rule — never in lifted white cards or floating media frames.

dos: Do keep specialty as the glow label on the chassis cap.
Do present skills and projects as labeled banks with chassis-edge rules and tube indexes where used.
Do put proof imagery in inset tube wells with hard edges.
Do use Chakra Petch only for name, lead, and project/detail titles; mono everywhere else.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by disabling tube pulse and link transitions.
donts: Don't flood large surfaces with nixie orange — glow is signal, not a theme wash.
Don't introduce soft cards, pills, or non-zero radius on this chassis.
Don't replace plate/steel type roles or swap display/mono pairings.
Don't add floating badges, kickers, or promo chips on tube media.
Don't invent filled primary buttons; interaction stays as instrument links and edge rules.
